_doc: Endgame W/D/L candidates (the method page, sections 11-12; the protocol of that test, amendments 6-6d), frozen on development data (train fit, dev judged). Per candidate: the Maia policy it reads ('valpass': the engine's value pass; 'input': an extra pass at the input rating) and its residual terms per use: 'groups' (Fast, Stockfish values, one rating), 'groups_opp' (Fast, both ratings given, as Siby), 'accurate' / 'accurate_opp' (Accurate, Leela values, Classical only); per '<Mode>|<venue>' the terms for the position ('root') and for a move ('after'): material classes, men fade (m0, tau), odd terms (added to t) and even terms (added to ln nu). Fast Classical reads the V2 Stockfish values the engine uses. Blitz online: no entry (unchanged). P1d (pooled) uses P1a's terms in Accurate. Read by nn/wdl_endgame_p1.py. Version 3 (amendment 6e, 8 November): Rapid online removed from every candidate (never changed, like Blitz online): on high-rated Lichess rapid games the correction gives nothing on the both-ratings path and loses at the top (the method page). Every other term is the frozen version 2's. Version 4 (amendment 8, 8-9 November): candidates P2a and P2c added: the base formula refitted where the rule adopts it (key 'base': 'sf_opp' = Fast with both ratings given; Classical and Blitz online), and the endgame terms refitted on top of it with the same terms for the position ('root') and the move ('after'). P1a-P1d unchanged.

P1a.doc: refit P1: P1's features with Maia's policy from the engine's value pass (no extra Maia pass)

P1b.doc: original P1 (section 10): Maia's policy at the engine's input rating (one extra Maia pass)

P1c.doc: conservative refit: as P1a without the material-class terms, ten times the shrinkage (l2 1e-2)

P1d.doc: pooled refit: as P1a with one set of terms for the four groups (each keeps its own engine formula)

P2a.doc: version 4 (J-a): refitted base (both ratings, Classical and Blitz online) + endgame terms, one set for the position and the move view

P2c.doc: version 4 (J-c): refitted base (both ratings, Classical and Blitz online) + endgame terms, one set for the position and the move view
